If you are looking for Oxford ELLT accepted universities in UK for 2027 entry, the current picture is encouraging. More than 100 UK universities and higher education institutions recognise Oxford ELLT for admissions, although acceptance criteria can vary by institution, programme and study route.

Finding an ELLT accepted university in UK is only the first step. You should also check whether your chosen course accepts ELLT Digital, ELLT Global or both, what overall and component scores are required, and whether additional academic or English-language requirements apply.

This guide is written for students planning 2027 entry. Where a university has not yet published a specific 2027 English-language policy, the information below uses its latest available requirements rather than presenting an unconfirmed future policy as fact.

How This List Was Checked

We used the official Oxford ELLT partner directory as the starting point, then cross-checked key universities against their own English-language requirement pages.

Oxford ELLT currently reports more than 300 partner institutions worldwide and more than 100 UK universities and higher education institutions. Acceptance can still vary by institution and programme.

That matters because a partner list and a course-level admission rule are not quite the same thing. A university may recognise Oxford ELLT but set different requirements for undergraduate, postgraduate, foundation, pre-sessional or professional courses.

For the most accurate decision, use this page to build your shortlist, then verify your exact course before paying for a test.

What Is Oxford ELLT?

ELLT stands for English Language Level Test. Oxford ELLT, developed by Oxford International Digital Institute, assesses reading, listening, writing and speaking.

There are two main formats:

  • Oxford ELLT Digital: taken remotely online.
  • Oxford ELLT Global: taken at an authorised test centre.

Both currently cost £120 and normally return results within 48 hours. Oxford ELLT states that a test result remains valid for 18 months from the date of issue. Check the current Oxford ELLT test information before booking.

If you are comparing several English tests, it may help to understand how UK universities assess English-language evidence and other routes that can reduce reliance on IELTS.

The university name answers only one question. The useful questions are what format, what score, what components and what route.

University of Leeds

Leeds is a useful example because it shows why "ELLT accepted" is not enough.

The university currently specifies Oxford ELLT Global. For an IELTS 6.0 profile with no less than 5.5 in each component, Leeds lists ELLT Global 6 overall with no less than 5 in each component. For an IELTS 6.5 profile with no less than 6.0, it lists ELLT Global 7 overall with no less than 6.

Leeds also says accepted test results cannot be more than two years old at the intended course start date. Check the latest Leeds English-test equivalencies.

If Leeds is on your shortlist, check the format before booking. Digital may be more convenient, but convenience does not override the admission rule.

Aberystwyth University

Aberystwyth publishes course-dependent requirements. Some undergraduate profiles use ELLT 6 with at least 5 in each component, while others use ELLT 7 with minimum 5s.

Postgraduate requirements can be higher depending on the department. That is why a single "minimum ELLT score for the UK" can be misleading.

Check Aberystwyth's current English requirements against the course you want.

University of Westminster

Westminster currently accepts Oxford ELLT Digital and Global, as well as Oxford ELLT Skill Retake.

Students in Bangladesh, India and Pakistan are strongly recommended to take ELLT Global at an approved test centre.

For a Bachelor's course requiring IELTS 6.0 overall, Westminster currently maps the requirement to ELLT 6 overall with 5 in each skill. Many Master's courses requiring IELTS 6.5 use ELLT 7, with component requirements depending on the course.

Check the current Westminster equivalency table.

For a Bangladeshi applicant, that Global recommendation is not a minor technical detail. It can affect which test you should book from the start.

Reading lists Oxford ELLT among its acceptable English-language tests and applies offer-specific score conditions.

The useful lesson here is not to copy one ELLT number from another university. Use the current Reading accepted-test information alongside your actual offer or course requirement.

UWE Bristol

UWE Bristol currently lists ELLT Level 6 with at least Level 5 in all components for undergraduate entry and Level 7 for postgraduate entry.

There is an important regional restriction:

Oxford ELLT Digital cannot currently be accepted from applicants from South Asia.

Check the latest UWE Bristol English-language requirements before choosing Digital.

That single restriction can be more useful to a Bangladeshi applicant than another 20 university names.

Do not stop at the overall score. A university may require ELLT 7 overall and still insist on a particular minimum in writing, speaking, listening or reading.

Students considering alternatives can compare universities that accept PTE or where Duolingo may be accepted before choosing a test.

Oxford ELLT vs IELTS: Which Is Better for UK Admission?

There is no universal winner.

IELTS has broader recognition and offers UKVI-approved versions for routes that require a Secure English Language Test. Oxford ELLT can be a practical alternative when your chosen university explicitly accepts it, particularly if the published ELLT score and format suit your application.

For example, a Master's course using an IELTS 6.5 profile may map that requirement to ELLT 7, but the minimum component scores can still differ by university.

That is why an Oxford ELLT vs IELTS decision should begin with the course requirement rather than with which test feels easier.

If you do not want to assume IELTS is your only route, review other English-language options used by UK universities alongside the exact admissions policy for your course.

Oxford ELLT Cost and Skill Retake Fees

Oxford ELLT Digital and Oxford ELLT Global currently cost £120 each.

Eligible students can also use Oxford ELLT Skill Retake.

Oxford ELLT says eligible candidates have 10 days after receiving their result to book a retake. Only one eligible module is retaken, and the new result replaces the original score for that module.

That last point catches some students out. The replacement score applies even if it is lower.

Check the current Skill Retake rules before paying.

How Long Is an Oxford ELLT Result Valid?

Oxford ELLT states that its result is valid for 18 months from the date of issue.

Universities can also apply their own rules about how recent an English-language qualification needs to be. Leeds, for example, says accepted test results cannot be more than two years old at the intended course start date.

These are two separate checks.

For safe planning, meet the stricter condition that applies to your application.

Is Oxford ELLT Accepted for UK Universities?

University acceptance requirements can vary depending on the institution, programme, and study level.

UK universities may set their own English-language requirements and decide which English tests they accept for admission. Requirements can differ based on the course, academic level, and required English proficiency standard.

This is why an Oxford ELLT accepted university in UK may accept the test for certain programmes while applying different score requirements, test formats, or component minimums for other courses.

Some programmes, including pre-sessional and specialised courses, may have additional English-language criteria.

Before choosing Oxford ELLT, students should check the specific English-language requirements published by their chosen university and course. Comparing Oxford ELLT with other accepted English tests can also help students understand which option best matches their application needs.

The practical rule is simple: always check the university and course requirement before booking an English-language test.

How to Apply to a UK University with Oxford ELLT

Start with the course, not the test.

  1. Choose your university and course.
  2. Confirm that Oxford ELLT is accepted.
  3. Check whether Digital, Global or both are allowed.
  4. Record the required overall and component scores.
  5. Take the test early enough to leave room for a retake if needed.
  6. Submit the result and meet the English condition on your offer.
  7. Follow the university's admissions and enrolment instructions.

Undergraduate applicants can fit these steps into the UK undergraduate application process.

If you are deciding when to begin, compare January start options with the main autumn intake.

Oxford ELLT Is Not the Same as Oxford Test of English

Students searching for Oxford test accepted universities in UK may be referring to two different qualifications.

Oxford ELLT and Oxford Test of English are separate tests with different score scales and university policies.

Do not assume that acceptance of one means acceptance of the other.

If your search was Oxford ELLT test accepted university in UK, make sure the admissions page specifically names Oxford ELLT before relying on the requirement.

This distinction also helps search systems understand which Oxford-related test this page is actually about.

Frequently Asked Questions

Which Oxford ELLT accepted universities are in the UK?

Oxford ELLT says more than 100 UK universities and higher education institutions recognise the test. Current examples include Bristol, Leeds, Plymouth, Reading, Westminster, Derby, Dundee, Portsmouth, Hertfordshire, Kent, Roehampton and many others.

Is there an ELLT accepted university in UK for 2027 entry?

Yes. Many UK institutions currently recognise Oxford ELLT, so students planning 2027 entry have multiple options.

However, a university should not be described as "2027 confirmed" until its relevant future policy or course requirement is published.

How many Oxford ELLT accepted universities in UK are there?

Oxford ELLT currently reports more than 100 UK universities and higher education institutions that recognise the test.

Because the partner network and programme rules can change, verify the live partner status and the university's own course requirement before applying.

Is Oxford ELLT Level 7 equal to IELTS 6.5?

ELLT 7 is commonly used for university profiles corresponding to IELTS 6.5. The actual component requirement can still differ by university or course.

What CEFR level is Oxford ELLT 7?

Universities can present equivalencies slightly differently, so use the score profile published for your specific course rather than relying on CEFR alone.

Does every UK university accept ELLT Digital?

No.

Leeds currently specifies Oxford ELLT Global, while UWE Bristol says Oxford ELLT Digital cannot currently be accepted from South Asian applicants.

Always check the test format before booking.

How much does Oxford ELLT cost?

Oxford ELLT Digital and Oxford ELLT Global currently cost £120 each.

How long is an Oxford ELLT result valid?

Oxford ELLT states that its result is valid for 18 months from the date of issue.

A university may also apply its own rule about how recent an English-language test needs to be.

Can I retake one ELLT skill?

Eligible candidates can retake Reading, Listening, or Writing and Speaking as a combined module.

Current fees are £50 for Reading, £50 for Listening and £70 for Writing and Speaking.

Which countries accept Oxford ELLT?

Oxford ELLT reports more than 300 partner institutions worldwide. Students searching for Oxford ELLT accepted countries should still verify the individual institution because recognition is not automatically country-wide.

This page intentionally focuses on UK admission so that the main search intent remains clear.

Final Check Before You Book

Oxford ELLT can be a practical English-language route for students applying to UK universities, but a university name on a partner list is not enough.

A Leeds applicant may need Global. A South Asian applicant considering UWE Bristol needs to know the current Digital restriction. A standard Plymouth applicant still needs to match the score profile required by the course.

Use the official Oxford ELLT partner directory as your partner-status check, then confirm the exact requirement on the university's own website.

If you are still comparing destinations and courses, explore UK study options alongside your admission plan.
